author: haofan170
quote: I spent half of GTA 6 wondering whether I was playing Grand Theft Auto or Red Dead Redemption with cars. I play GTA to do all the reckless, ridiculous **** I’d never dare do in real life. I want to see how much chaos I can cause and how long I can get away with it. That’s the **** now there’s a **** honor system. You want the good ending? Better keep your head down and stop killing people. In Grand Theft Auto. Why am I spending the whole game on my best behavior in a series built around doing whatever the hell I want?So I spent the entire story crawling around like some powerless nobody, waiting for the moment I’d finally get to call the shots. Then the credits rolled, and my big reward for behaving myself was ending up as just another ordinary person. What was the point?If I wanted to spend hours behaving myself just to end up exactly where I started, I’d go to work. At least I’d get paid.
